data.exact_reserve_text: The profit on the technical account of GBP 66.5m (2019: profit GBP 31.2m) includes a run-off deficit of GBP 33.5m for prior accident years (2019: GBP 18.5m deficit). data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 gross claims outstanding were GBP 735.6m. During 2020 the Syndicate recorded an aggregate prior accident year run-off deficit (adverse development) of GBP 33.5m (strengthening of reserves). This deterioration was driven by a mix of factors including prior-year marine deterioration (notably the Golden Ray vessel grounding) and reinsurance/subrogation effects from wildfire events (notably Camp Wildfire) which produced gross improvements in some respects but net adverse impacts after reinsurance. Reinsurance accepted business accounted for a material portion of the prior year deterioration (deficit of GBP 20.3m) with direct business showing a deficit of GBP 13.2m.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure taken from the managing agent's 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative which states a run-off deficit of GBP 33.5m. The note does not present an explicit multi-column table labelled 'Insurance liabilities (gross)' for the aggregate PYD total; the narrative is used as the authoritative gross movement. Some event-level amounts are described as gross vs net (both provided in text) and reinsurance/subrogation effects complicate net vs gross interpretation. Claims development triangle is available and shown in thousands; no RITC distortion flagged. Where LOB-level PYD was not explicitly given, event-specific gross amounts were used and an overall direct/treaty split from the narrative was applied.
